C0421.title: Guangdong Criminal Gang Built Illegal Payment Aggregation Platforms to Provide Settlement Services for Overseas Online Gambling
C0421.summary: Starting June 2023, a criminal gang led by Li constructed multiple illegal payment aggregation platforms integrating third-party payment functions. They colluded with e-commerce shops, card sellers, and virtual currency dealers to provide end-to-end illegal fund settlement services for overseas online gambling platforms by guiding gamblers to purchase overpriced prepaid cards.
